verdict.rationale: mParticle documents outbound integrations to 'data warehousing solutions' (docs-11) and generic 'Forward data to downstream services' (docs-25), implying events/profiles can be routed to a warehouse destination, but the only warehouse-specific feature detailed in the pack — 'Warehouse Sync' — is explicitly described as ingesting data FROM the warehouse INTO mParticle, not exporting mParticle data out on a customer-controlled schedule (mparticle-docs-x4). No documentation shows a scheduled, engineer-controlled batch/export pipeline to Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or S3 as a destination. Missing for 10: explicit outbound warehouse export docs (schedule/cadence control, ClickHouse/S3 support, SQL/schema mapping for export direction), independent confirmation of reliable outbound sync.
